method.scope: single reactor; closed-loop fixed-count TCP connect + request write + exact response bytes + separate EOF + immediate TSV writes
method.connect_window: at most 256 pending TCP connects; the reactor polls and sends request bytes while additional lanes are launched; socket deadlines are checked every 25 ms instead of scanning all active sockets for every event batch
method.observer_failure_policy: stop new requests after first failure; drain active attempts; no retry
method.timing_compatibility: separate protocol; do not pool with V1, V2 or V3.2
method.concurrency_gauge_scope: client request states through EOF handling; not accepted server sockets, sessions or users
